texts:
### Q1
No. SQLite (node:sqlite) was rejected because ops runs a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files, so a binary file would break their backup checks. The store stays a plain-text JSON file, and we debounced the writes instead.

### Q2
Yes, `src/legacy/`. The platform team's sync job overwrites that folder every Monday, so any change would be silently lost. `docs/erp-api.md` is also off limits because the ERP team owns it.

### Q3
The signature is a top-level `sig` field in the JSON body. It is an HMAC-SHA256 hex digest over the compact JSON without `sig`, and it is enabled by `ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. We first tried an `X-Signature` header, but the ERP gateway strips custom `X-` headers, so the ERP saw every request as unsigned.

### Q4
Port 9911, since the October infra move. The README, the docs and `config/default.json` still say 8080.

### Q5
Every new user-facing `message` must be in German, because warehouse staff see them verbatim. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Old English messages are left as they are.

### Q6
It uses a hardcoded list of Austrian public holidays in `src/services/holidays.ts`, covering 2026 and 2027 only. `isBusinessDay` in `eta.ts` consults it. It's hardcoded because the deployment has no outbound internet. The list must be extended before 2028.

### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to any array payload, so it accepts only one event object per request. Batching was declined as a dead end.

### Q8
No new npm packages, runtime or dev. Each package needs a security review of about 6 weeks.

### Q9
Yes, but not in this repo. A memoized version written elsewhere, probably QA's build, showed stale ETAs in the list after a new tracking event, and a correct cache key got messy. So caching is a dead end, ETAs are computed fresh per request, and a "list eta is never stale" test guards it. Pagination is planned for later.

### Q10
There are 3 attempts in total with a fixed 30 s delay and no backoff. They retry on network errors, timeouts and 5xx, but not on 4xx. The reason is that the ERP dedupes by `event_id` only within 2 minutes, and the worst case is 75 s.

### Q11
Never log the recipient's name, address or phone, on any log line. It's personal data under GDPR, and the DPO flagged it in an audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.

### Q12
Yes, "emits webhook on delivered" in `test/events.test.ts` (OPS-412, owned by the platform team). If it fails, rerun once and don't try to fix it.

### Q13
ATP numbers are validated as UPU S10 including the check digit, with the code `INVALID_TRACKING_NUMBER`. All other carriers accept any non-empty value. Carrier formats change often, and valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for 2 days last year.

### Q14
`fs.watch` never fires on staging, because the config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host and change events don't propagate into the container. `fs.watchFile`, which polls, worked. Nothing has been built yet.

### Q15
Yes, `GET /shipments/:id`. The mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on added or missing fields, and the next mobile release is in January. The `eta` field is added only to the list items.
Nothing in that message was new. The quiz only covered facts already in the ledger, so I left it unchanged.
